items.title: ContextMemory content half: H1 contrastive leg RE-RUN on the redesigned mutual-information instrument (8-cluster x slot contingency, shuffle-corrected NMI, fresh/held-out load-bearing; seed-matched untrained + refractory k=2 + content-blind diversity arms); supersedes V3-EXQ-970
items.note: Campaign W4-S3 item 1 (chip-20260907-campaign-w4-s3-contextmemory-content; member chip chip-20260906-ctxmem-instrument-redesign-970a). USER DECISION 2026-09-06 (substrate entry contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy, decision_2026_09_06): the content half is measured, not decided; this is the H1 contrastive leg RE-RUN on the redesigned instrument, executing implementation_hint (1) verbatim -- mutual information over the FULL (cluster x slot) contingency table (NMI_excess = I/H(class) minus a 200-permutation label-shuffle null), PROBE_CLUSTERS=8 (>=4), per-draw contingency tables recorded for every probe, FRESH-cluster / genuinely held-out readout load-bearing (trained-set secondary), held-out sized as a FRACTION of realised episodes (40 collection episodes with every optimiser stopped; per-cell adequacy >=24 per class; unit needs >=7 adequate pairs), objective-convergence P0 precondition on every trained arm (worst cell, >=2% of the objective's range), dv_headroom declared (kind dv_headroom via _metrics.dv_headroom_check, ceiling_headroom above the UNTRAINED control). ARMS x 8 seeds x 2 regimes: UNTRAINED (gumbel_learned, tagger frozen, seed-matched null), H1_CONTRASTIVE (gumbel_learned + contrastive loss w=0.5 through real SGD, every step), DIVERSITY_956 (gumbel_learned + contextmemory_write_addressing_loss_weight=0.5 through the substrate path -- 956's operating point; H1 says a content-referencing objective is REQUIRED so this content-blind arm should NOT raise the DV), REFRACTORY_K2 (interim-enablement reference, descriptive). Regime A = real agent, 100 train + 40 held-out episodes, safe/dangerous contexts STEP-MATCHED to post-reset steps 1..4 in both classes; Regime B = synthetic 8-cluster stream, 15000 SGD steps, fresh bases load-bearing. LOAD-BEARING: pass(A,H1) OR pass(B,H1), each = unit gate green AND mean paired NMI_excess elevation >= 0.10 AND exact sign-flip p < 0.0125 (Bonferroni 2 regimes x 2 trained arms; 8 seeds -> p-floor 1/256). Secondary: H1_content_reference_required (DIVERSITY_956 scored and not passing wherever H1 passes). INTERIM ENABLEMENT DECLARED BY HAND: chip-20260906-ctxmem-enablement-lint (HK-B item 7) had not landed (open, unclaimed, 2026-09-07); gumbel_learned is used only in this content-discrimination experiment with the tagger trained by real SGD; refractory k=2 is the reference arm; library default untouched. dv_headroom MEASURED BEFORE PRE-REGISTRATION (authoring-time probe, seeds 1-6 disjoint from SEEDS, N=1500): at K=8 jitter 0.078 the untrained fresh-cluster null is 0.078+-0.060 with 92% of clusters spread over >=2 slots (continuous statistic; the legacy 0.0078 jitter quantises it to a 5-level collision count), design-time contrastive control reaches 0.260+-0.036 (all paired diffs >= +0.09), diversity control 0.294+-0.029, probe repeat-noise SD 0.006 -> NMI_MARGIN = max(0.10, 3 x 0.006) = 0.10. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): the decisive readout (shuffle-corrected NMI over a cluster x slot contingency table, fresh/held-out) is recorded in NO manifest -- 956/969/970/971/972 recorded occupied-SET Jaccard only, no contingency tables; not recoverable, run fresh. Step 2.5b: N/A (claim_ids=[]; autopsy 2026-09-03 Step 5 records the brake released by user decision). Step 2.5c (re-checked 2026-09-07): open corrupting overlaps = the entry UNDER TEST (e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write) plus mode-governance-engagement / SD-082 / SD-e1-rollout-consistency-training, all removed by construction as 970 documents. red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> 5 findings + 3 notes, ALL FIXED before queueing (no re-spawn; none BLOCKING): F1 gate-red control read as refutation -> necessity sub-claim now requires the control SCORED (else label ..._necessity_unscored_*); F2 not-ready label only when all 4 units red -> now when neither H1 unit is scorable, non_degenerate from H1 units; F3 within-A ~15x tagger-update asymmetry (H1 every 10 steps vs substrate loss every step) -> H1 injected every step, RNG-matched batch draws in all gumbel arms; F4 DIVERSITY convergence gate monitored a proxy batch -> monitors the trained consecutive-window form (agent.py construction under no_grad); F5 context aliased with time-since-reset (dangerous episodes ~4 steps, z_self EMA-attenuated) -> both classes step-matched to steps 1..4, per-class latent norms recorded (smoke: z_self 0.36 vs 0.32); N1 label regime pattern; N2 held-out 20 -> 40 episodes; N3 training-phase write count + per-cell held-out adequacy replacing a whole-unit floor. Smoke PASS (--dry-run 2026-09-07, 10+4 episodes x 15 steps, 1 seed): every trained arm's objective monitored in both regimes, contingency tables recorded for all 8 cells, validate_experiments --strict OK, validate_recording --strict OK on the relocated dry manifest, ep N/M and verdict lines present, z_goal_stream unmeasured (expected). Toy-scale outcome FAIL/instrument_gate_not_ready is expected (writepath floor 200, held-out floor, convergence all unreachable in 14 episodes). Does NOT lift the substrate entry's status; the autopsy/governance adjudicates. COST: 32 Regime A cells x 140 episodes (970's 24 cells ran in 17.5 min on ree-cloud-2) + 32 Regime B cells; estimated_minutes approximate.
